title: About the “Sanfu Days” in Summer
synopsis: Learn about Sanfu, the three 10 day periods that are the hottest periods of summer!

fullText.simplified:
夏天“三伏天”里的讲究

    俗话说：“冷在三九，热在三伏。”中国人常说的三伏天一般是7月中旬到8月上旬这段时间，分成初伏、中伏和末伏，每个伏天都是10天。
    三伏天是一年中气温最高而且潮湿、闷热的日子。人们会在这么热的日子里做些什么呢？
    先说吃：北方人会在头伏第一天吃饺子。因为饺子看起来像“元宝”，“伏”与“福”同音，所以吃饺子寓意“福气”。另外，到了夏天，天气热，人们的食欲就会下降，饺子在传统习俗里正是开胃解馋的食物。
    南方地区湖南、江西等地，头伏吃鸡肉。因为三伏天里人的体能消耗较多，必须适当补充营养。鸡肉和鸡汤是大补的食物。
    再来看看人们会做什么。中国人讲究“冬病夏治”。尤其是鼻炎、肺炎、哮喘等这些冬季高发病，在三伏期间，贴“三伏贴”可以改善体质，缓解症状。“三伏贴”是通过中医传统的内病外治的方法，用药物刺激穴位，提高身体对“冬病”的抵抗能力，达到不发病或少发病的目的。所以每年一入伏，中医院贴三伏贴的人就多得不得了。
    进入三伏天，无论是饮食还是活动，都要更科学合理，要多喝水少喝酒，多吃瘦肉，鱼类、蛋类等食物，还要警惕“空调病”，只有这样才能保证在如此闷热的天气中过得健康快乐。
fullText.traditional:
夏天“三伏天”裡的講究

    俗話說：“冷在三九，熱在三伏。”中國人常說的三伏天一般是7月中旬到8月上旬這段時間，分成初伏、中伏和末伏，每個伏天都是10天。
    三伏天是一年中氣溫最高而且潮濕、悶熱的日子。人們會在這麼熱的日子裡做些什麼呢？
    先說吃：北方人會在頭伏第一天吃餃子。因為餃子看起來像“元寶”，“伏”與“福”同音，所以吃餃子寓意“福氣”。另外，到了夏天，天氣熱，人們的食慾就會下降，餃子在傳統習俗裡正是開胃解饞的食物。
    南方地區湖南、江西等地，頭伏吃雞肉。因為三伏天裡人的體能消耗較多，必須適當補充營養。雞肉和雞湯是大補的食物。
    再來看看人們會做什麼。中國人講究“冬病夏治”。尤其是鼻炎、肺炎、哮喘等這些冬季高發病，在三伏期間，貼“三伏貼”可以改善體質，緩解症狀。“三伏貼”是通過中醫傳統的內病外治的方法，用藥物刺激穴位，提高身體對“冬病”的抵抗能力，達到不發病或少發病的目的。所以每年一入伏，中醫院貼三伏貼的人就多得不得了。
    進入三伏天，無論是飲食還是活動，都要更科學合理，要多喝水少喝酒，多吃瘦肉，魚類、蛋類等食物，還要警惕“空調病”，只有這樣才能保證在如此悶熱的天氣中過得健康快樂。

sentences.english: About the “Sanfu Days” in Summer

sentences.simplified: 俗话说：“冷在三九，热在三伏。”
sentences.traditional: 俗話說：“冷在三九，熱在三伏。”
sentences.pinyin: sú huà shuō lěng zài sān jiǔ rè zài sān fú

sentences.simplified: 中国人常说的三伏天一般是7月中旬到8月上旬这段时间，
sentences.traditional: 中國人常說的三伏天一般是7月中旬到8月上旬這段時間，
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó rén cháng shuō de sān fú tiān yì bān shì 1 yuè zhōng xún dào 1 yuè shàng xún zhè duàn shí jiān
sentences.english: As the saying goes, it’s “cold during Sanjiu, and hot during Sanfu”.

sentences.simplified: 分成初伏、中伏和末伏，每个伏天都是10天。
sentences.traditional: 分成初伏、中伏和末伏，每個伏天都是10天。
sentences.pinyin: fēn chéng chū fú zhōng fú hé mò fú měi ge fú tiān dōu shì 1 tiān
sentences.english: Chinese people often say that Sanfu generally starts in the middle of July and ends in early August.
Sanfu is divided into the first, middle, and last period. Each period lasts for 10 days.

sentences.simplified: 三伏天是一年中气温最高而且潮湿、闷热的日子。
sentences.traditional: 三伏天是一年中氣溫最高而且潮濕、悶熱的日子。
sentences.pinyin: sān fú tiān shì yì nián zhōng qì wēn zuì gāo ér qiě cháo shī mēn rè de rì zi

sentences.simplified: 人们会在这么热的日子里做些什么呢？
sentences.traditional: 人們會在這麼熱的日子裡做些什麼呢？
sentences.pinyin: rén men huì zài zhè me rè de rì zi lǐ zuò xiē shén me ne
sentences.english: Sanfu is the time of year with the hottest temperatures, and it’s humid and stifling hot during this period.
What do people do during such hot days?

sentences.simplified: 先说吃：北方人会在头伏第一天吃饺子。
sentences.traditional: 先說吃：北方人會在頭伏第一天吃餃子。
sentences.pinyin: xiān shuō chī běi fāng rén huì zài tóu fú dì yī tiān chī jiǎo zi

sentences.simplified: 因为饺子看起来像“元宝”，“伏”与“福”同音，
sentences.traditional: 因為餃子看起來像“元寶”，“伏”與“福”同音，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi jiǎo zi kàn qi lai xiàng yuán bǎo fú yǔ fú tóng yīn
sentences.english: Let’s start with what people eat. Northerners eat dumplings on the first day of the first period.

sentences.simplified: 所以吃饺子寓意“福气”。
sentences.traditional: 所以吃餃子寓意“福氣”。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ chī jiǎo zi yù yì fú qi
sentences.english: Because dumplings look like “gold ingots”, and because the “fu” in Sanfu is a homophone of ”good fortune”, ..

sentences.simplified: 另外，到了夏天，天气热，人们的食欲就会下降，
sentences.traditional: 另外，到了夏天，天氣熱，人們的食慾就會下降，
sentences.pinyin: lìng wài dào le xià tiān tiān qì rè rén men de shí yù jiù huì xià jiàng
sentences.english: .. eating dumplings means “good fortune”.

sentences.simplified: 饺子在传统习俗里正是开胃解馋的食物。
sentences.traditional: 餃子在傳統習俗裡正是開胃解饞的食物。
sentences.pinyin: jiǎo zi zài chuán tǒng xí sú lǐ zhèng shì kāi wèi jiě chán de shí wù
sentences.english: In addition, when summer comes, and the weather gets hot, people will have less of an appetite.
Dumplings are a food that whets the appetite according to traditional customs.

sentences.simplified: 南方地区湖南、江西等地，头伏吃鸡肉。
sentences.traditional: 南方地區湖南、江西等地，頭伏吃雞肉。
sentences.pinyin: nán fāng dì qū hú nán jiāng xī děng dì tóu fú chī jī ròu

sentences.simplified: 因为三伏天里人的体能消耗较多，必须适当补充营养。
sentences.traditional: 因為三伏天裡人的體能消耗較多，必須適當補充營養。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi sān fú tiān lǐ rén de tǐ néng xiāo hào jiào duō bì xū shì dàng bǔ chōng yíng yǎng
sentences.english: In southern areas such as Hunan and Jiangxi, people eat chicken during the period of Sanfu.

sentences.simplified: 鸡肉和鸡汤是大补的食物。
sentences.traditional: 雞肉和雞湯是大補的食物。
sentences.pinyin: jī ròu hé jī tāng shì dà bǔ de shí wù
sentences.english: As people exert more physical energy during Sanfu, they need the right nutrition.
Chicken meat and chicken soup are considered to be tonics.

sentences.simplified: 再来看看人们会做什么。中国人讲究“冬病夏治”。
sentences.traditional: 再來看看人們會做什麼。中國人講究“冬病夏治”。
sentences.pinyin: zài lái kàn kan rén men huì zuò shén me zhōng guó rén jiǎng jiu dōng bìng xià zhì

sentences.simplified: 尤其是鼻炎、肺炎、哮喘等这些冬季高发病，
sentences.traditional: 尤其是鼻炎、肺炎、哮喘等這些冬季高發病，
sentences.pinyin: yóu qí shì bí yán fèi yán xiào chuǎn děng zhè xiē dōng jì gāo fā bìng
sentences.english: Now let’s take a look at what people do. Chinese people believe in “treating winter diseases in summer”.

sentences.simplified: 在三伏期间，贴“三伏贴”可以改善体质，缓解症状。
sentences.traditional: 在三伏期間，貼“三伏貼”可以改善體質，緩解症狀。
sentences.pinyin: zài sān fú qī jiān tiē sān fú tiē kě yǐ gǎi shàn tǐ zhì huǎn jiě zhèng zhuàng
sentences.english: Especially when it comes to diseases that are common during winter, like rhinitis, pneumonia, and asthma, ..

sentences.simplified: “三伏贴”是通过中医传统的内病外治的方法，
sentences.traditional: “三伏貼”是通過中醫傳統的內病外治的方法，
sentences.pinyin: sān fú tiē shì tōng guò zhōng yī chuán tǒng de nèi bìng wài zhì de fāng fǎ
sentences.english: .. during Sanfu, applying “Sanfutie” can improve your physical condition and alleviate the symptoms.

sentences.simplified: 用药物刺激穴位，提高身体对“冬病”的抵抗能力，
sentences.traditional: 用藥物刺激穴位，提高身體對“冬病”的抵抗能力，
sentences.pinyin: yòng yào wù cì jī xué wèi tí gāo shēn tǐ duì dōng bìng de dǐ kàng néng lì
sentences.english: “Sanfutie” is a method of “external treatment of internal diseases” from traditional Chinese medicine, ..

sentences.simplified: 达到不发病或少发病的目的。
sentences.traditional: 達到不發病或少發病的目的。
sentences.pinyin: dá dào bù fā bìng huò shǎo fā bìng de mù dì
sentences.english: .. stimulating acupuncture points with medicine, increasing the body’s resistance to “winter diseases”, ..

sentences.simplified: 所以每年一入伏，中医院贴三伏贴的人就多得不得了。
sentences.traditional: 所以每年一入伏，中醫院貼三伏貼的人就多得不得了。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ měi nián yí rù fú zhōng yī yuàn tiē sān fú tiē de rén jiù duō de bù dé liǎo
sentences.english: .. to achieve the purpose of not falling ill or avoiding frequent illness.
Therefore, every year when Sanfu starts, a great number of people apply Sanfutie in Chinese medicine hospitals.

sentences.simplified: 进入三伏天，无论是饮食还是活动，都要更科学合理，
sentences.traditional: 進入三伏天，無論是飲食還是活動，都要更科學合理，
sentences.pinyin: jìn rù sān fú tiān wú lùn shì yǐn shí hái shi huó dòng dōu yào gèng kē xué hé lǐ

sentences.simplified: 要多喝水少喝酒，多吃瘦肉，鱼类、蛋类等食物，
sentences.traditional: 要多喝水少喝酒，多吃瘦肉，魚類、蛋類等食物，
sentences.pinyin: yào duō hē shuǐ shǎo hē jiǔ duō chī shòu ròu yú lèi dàn lèi děng shí wù
sentences.english: When Sanfu starts, both diet and activities should be more scientific and rational.

sentences.simplified: 还要警惕“空调病”，
sentences.traditional: 還要警惕“空調病”，
sentences.pinyin: hái yào jǐng tì kōng tiáo bìng
sentences.english: People should drink more water and less alcohol, and also eat more foods like lean meat, fish, and eggs.

sentences.simplified: 只有这样才能保证在如此闷热的天气中过得健康快乐。
sentences.traditional: 只有這樣才能保證在如此悶熱的天氣中過得健康快樂。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu zhè yàng cái néng bǎo zhèng zài rú cǐ mēn rè de tiān qì zhōng guò de jiàn kāng kuài lè
sentences.english: Moreover, people should be vigilant against “air conditioning disease”.
Only by doing these things can we make sure we’re healthy and happy in such stifling hot weather.

Chinese people often say that Sanfu generally starts in the middle of July and ends in early August.
Sanfu is divided into the first, middle, and last period. Each period lasts for 10 days.
Sanfu is the time of year with the hottest temperatures, and it’s humid and stifling hot during this period.
What do people do during such hot days?
Let’s start with what people eat. Northerners eat dumplings on the first day of the first period.
Because dumplings look like “gold ingots”, and because the “fu” in Sanfu is a homophone of ”good fortune”, ..
.. eating dumplings means “good fortune”.
In addition, when summer comes, and the weather gets hot, people will have less of an appetite.
Dumplings are a food that whets the appetite according to traditional customs.
In southern areas such as Hunan and Jiangxi, people eat chicken during the period of Sanfu.
As people exert more physical energy during Sanfu, they need the right nutrition.
Chicken meat and chicken soup are considered to be tonics.
Now let’s take a look at what people do. Chinese people believe in “treating winter diseases in summer”.
Especially when it comes to diseases that are common during winter, like rhinitis, pneumonia, and asthma, ..
.. during Sanfu, applying “Sanfutie” can improve your physical condition and alleviate the symptoms.
“Sanfutie” is a method of “external treatment of internal diseases” from traditional Chinese medicine, ..
.. stimulating acupuncture points with medicine, increasing the body’s resistance to “winter diseases”, ..
.. to achieve the purpose of not falling ill or avoiding frequent illness.
Therefore, every year when Sanfu starts, a great number of people apply Sanfutie in Chinese medicine hospitals.
When Sanfu starts, both diet and activities should be more scientific and rational.
People should drink more water and less alcohol, and also eat more foods like lean meat, fish, and eggs.
Moreover, people should be vigilant against “air conditioning disease”.
Only by doing these things can we make sure we’re healthy and happy in such stifling hot weather.
